Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to understand Acme's priorities around inference latency and cost per 1M tokens. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while keeping p95 latency < 250ms for customer-facing chat flows
- Workloads: mixed long + short sequences, heavy embedding usage for search/rerank
- Success metrics: 20-30% lower cost per query, sub-250ms p95 for key routes

Next step: technical deep dive + demo where Rafael (our SE) can walk through batching/quantization options and sizing. I can send a calendar invite once we lock a time — proposed slots next week:
- Thu, Apr 29 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri, Apr 30 10:00–11:00 PT

Could you confirm which works and who from your side will join? Also, if you can share the list of attendee roles (CTO, MLOps lead, infra), Rafael will tailor the demo.

Attaching a short mutual action plan and a draft agenda for the 60-min deep dive.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0178

Attachments: ACME-Mutual-Action-Plan.pdf, redwood-demo-agenda.docx
